verdict.rationale: DBOS ships official CLIs: the `dbos` CLI for project init and running workflows (dbos-docs-24, dbos-docs-41), and `dbosctl` for managing Conductor-hosted workflows/queues/schedules (dbos-docs-18, dbos-docs-33, dbos-probe-4), both well documented with concrete commands. missing for 10: independent/hands-on community confirmation of CLI usage specifically (most community evidence discusses SDK ergonomics, not CLI), and no evidence of AI-native features (e.g., natural-language or agent-oriented CLI commands) beyond standard devops commands.
